metaTitle: How to Run a Generator Safely at Camp
description: Run a portable generator safely at a campsite with CO rules, 20-foot placement, refueling steps, GFCI and cord tips, plus noise and campground etiquette.
directAnswer: Run the generator outdoors at least 20 feet from tents and vehicles, exhaust pointed away, with a battery CO alarm where you sleep. Refuel only when cool, keep it dry, use GFCI and proper cords, and follow campground quiet hours.
